data.name: Azeezah
data.gender_notes: Azeezah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Azeezah is derived from the word 'Aziz' which means 'mighty' or 'powerful'. This name is often used to describe someone who possesses great strength and power, both in a spiritual and physical sense. In Islamic tradition, Azeezah is also associated with the concept of Allah's divine power and omnipotence. The name Azeezah carries the meaning “Majestic, Almighty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azeezah usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, almighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's infinite power and strength.
data.etymology: Azeezah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Majestic, Almighty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azeezah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
